newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Flight, Pritzker in pact.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Flight, Pritzker in pact.

text.p: Interactive Flight Technologies Inc said Tuesday it agreed to form an alliance with Pritzker Interests of Chicago to market in-flight entertainment systems to major airlines.
Under the proposed agreement, Pritzker would invest up to $20 million in a joint venture to raise one-third of the money required for an airline project, Interactive Flight said.
Pritzker would also purchase up to $1 million of Interactive Flight's stock and gain a seat on the company's board, the company said.
Pritzker would also receive warrants to purchase up to 10 percent of Interactive Flight, based on implementation of the alliance.
The proposed deal remains subject to customary conditions.
